knowledgePoints.title: 一、主语
knowledgePoints.content: 句子的主体，是谓语陈述说明的对象——动作的发出者。充当主语的可以由名词、代词、v-ing、to do或者由what, that, how等引导的从句组成。
examples: The secret of success lies in one's patience.
To see is to believe.
Watching a movie is pleasure, but making a movie is hard work.
What he said annoyed the audience.
It is quite common these days for young people in many countries to have a break from studying after graduating from high school.

knowledgePoints.title: 二、谓语
knowledgePoints.content:
英语句子的灵魂；说明主语的动作、状态或特征——动作。充当谓语的形式：以某种时态形式出现的动词。
▲ 非常重要！一句话中只能有一个动词作谓语；如再出现动词则只能以：1）并列谓语；2）从句谓语；3）非谓语的形式出现！
examples: When he got up, a big plan occurred to him.
The watch is necessary in our daily life, but its function is too simple and dull.
We may have different opinions in organizing class activities.

knowledgePoints.title: 三、宾语
knowledgePoints.content: 动作行为的对象，跟在及物动词之后——动作的承受者。
examples: Some adults use a computer for other purposes, such as getting information or emailing friends.
The angel came to Joseph and told him the same thing.
Have you decided to quit the job?
Nobody believed what the speaker expressed.
Our success depends on how well we can cooperate with one another.

knowledgePoints.title: 四、表语
knowledgePoints.content: 说明主语的身份和情况（跟在系动词后）。系动词主要有：be动词，感官动词look, taste, smell, feel, sound；表状态变化的动词get, become, turn, grow, seem, appear, keep, remain, go
examples: The world inside the school walls is different from the world outside those walls.
Although the answer seemed a little strange, nobody but I doubted it.
The important thing is to learn and control your temper.
Several minutes passed but the whole class was in complete silence.

knowledgePoints.title: 五、补语
knowledgePoints.content: 作补充说明的功能，重点掌握宾补。主要出于这个结构：v. + n. + n./adj.
examples: They caught the boy stealing.
Popular science books can help us to become more interested in science and nature.
Many people felt their rewards unfair, especially when comparing their earnings with those of super stars.

knowledgePoints.title: 六、定语
knowledgePoints.content: 对名词进行修饰，按位置分为前置或后置定语。
examples: Everyone is attracted by the beautiful music.
He regretted the valuable time that he had wasted on the computer games.
In the 1960s a British car company which made very expensive cars was about to sell its latest car in Germany.

knowledgePoints.title: 七、同位语
knowledgePoints.content: 对前面的名词或代词进行补充说明或解释。
examples: Liuzhou, the dragon city, lies in the middle part of Guangxi Province.
Social sciences, the sciences that deal with human life, came into being in Europe in the early nineteenth century.
I hold the opinion that we should help them to overcome the present difficulty.
We are going to celebrate the Spring Festival, a holiday for all Chinese to get together and share happiness.

knowledgePoints.title: 八、状语
knowledgePoints.content: 可以修饰动词、形容词或者全句，表示行为发生的时间、地点、程度、频度、方式、伴随、原因、目的、比较等，位置灵活。状语可以由副词、介词短语、分词、不定式、从句组成。
examples: With his help, we worked out this problem.
Feeling satisfied with the waiter, he gave ten dollars as a tip.
To compete with others, more and more people equip themselves with a higher education.
After a long trip, he returned home, safe and sound.

exercises.question:
请划出下列句中的主语：
The teacher with two of his students is walking into the classroom.
exercises.explanation: 句子的主语是The teacher，是动作is walking的发出者。with two of his students是介词短语作定语。

exercises.question:
请划出下列句中的主语：
There is an old man coming here.
exercises.explanation: There be句型中，真正的主语是be动词后面的名词，即an old man。

exercises.question:
请划出下列句中的主语：
The useful dictionary was given by my mother last year.
exercises.explanation: 句子的主语是The useful dictionary，是动作was given的承受者（被动语态）。

exercises.question:
请划出下列句中的主语：
To do today's homework without the teacher's help is very difficult
exercises.correctAnswer: To do today's homework without the teacher's help
exercises.explanation: 不定式短语To do today's homework without the teacher's help作主语。

exercises.question:
请划出下列句中的谓语：
I don't like the picture on the wall.
exercises.explanation: 句子的谓语是don't like，说明主语I对picture的态度。

exercises.question:
请划出下列句中的谓语：
The days get longer and longer when summer comes.
exercises.explanation: 句子的谓语是get longer and longer，说明主语The days的状态变化。

exercises.question:
请划出下列句中的谓语：
Do you usually go to school by bus?
exercises.explanation: 疑问句中，助动词Do + 实义动词go构成谓语。

exercises.question:
请划出下列句中的谓语：
There will be a meeting at the library this afternoon.
exercises.explanation: There be句型中，谓语是will be。

exercises.question:
请划出下列句中的表语：
The old man was feeling very tired.
exercises.explanation: 句中的表语是very tired，说明主语the old man的状态。

exercises.question:
请划出下列句中的表语：
Why is he worried about Jim?
exercises.explanation: worried about Jim作表语，说明主语he的状态。

exercises.question:
请划出下列句中的表语：
The leaves have turned yellow.
exercises.explanation: yellow作表语，说明主语The leaves的颜色变化。

exercises.question:
请划出下列句中的表语：
Soon they all became interested in the subject.
exercises.explanation: interested in the subject作表语，说明主语they的状态。

exercises.question:
请划出下列句中的表语：
She was the first to learn about it.
options: the first to learn about it
exercises.correctAnswer: the first to learn about it
exercises.explanation: the first to learn about it作表语，说明主语She的身份。

exercises.question:
请划出下列句中的宾语：
My brother hasn't done his homework.
exercises.explanation: 句中的宾语是his homework，是动作done的承受者。

exercises.question:
请划出下列句中的宾语：
People all over the world speak English.
exercises.explanation: 句中的宾语是English，是动作speak的承受者。

exercises.question:
请划出下列句中的宾语：
You must pay good attention to your pronunciation.
exercises.explanation: 句中的宾语是good attention，pay attention to是固定搭配。

exercises.question:
请划出下列句中的宾语：
How many new words did you learn last class?
exercises.explanation: 句中的宾语是new words，是动作learn的承受者。

exercises.question:
请划出下列句中的宾语：
Some of the students in the school want to go swimming.
exercises.explanation: 句中的宾语是to go swimming，不定式短语作宾语。

exercises.question:
请划出下列句中的宾语补足语：
She likes the children to read newspapers and books in the reading-room.
exercises.correctAnswer: to read newspapers and books in the reading-room
exercises.explanation: 句中的宾语补足语是to read newspapers and books in the reading-room，对宾语the children进行补充说明。

exercises.question:
请划出下列句中的宾语补足语：
He asked her to take the boy out of school.
options: to take the boy out of school
exercises.correctAnswer: to take the boy out of school
exercises.explanation: 句中的宾语补足语是to take the boy out of school，对宾语her进行补充说明。

exercises.question:
请划出下列句中的直接宾语和间接宾语：
Please tell us a story.
options: tell=谓语，us=间接宾语，a story=直接宾语
tell=谓语，us=直接宾语，a story=间接宾语
Please=谓语，us=间接宾语，a story=直接宾语
tell=谓语，a story=直接宾语，us=间接宾语
exercises.correctAnswer: tell=谓语，us=间接宾语，a story=直接宾语
exercises.explanation: tell是谓语，us是间接宾语，a story是直接宾语。tell sb sth结构。

exercises.question:
请划出下列句中的直接宾语和间接宾语：
My father bought a new bike for me last week.
options: bought=谓语，a new bike=直接宾语，for me=介词短语
bought=谓语，a new bike=间接宾语，me=直接宾语
bought=谓语，a new bike=直接宾语，me=间接宾语
bought=谓语，me=直接宾语，a new bike=间接宾语
exercises.correctAnswer: bought=谓语，a new bike=直接宾语，me=间接宾语
exercises.explanation: bought是谓语，a new bike是直接宾语，me是间接宾语。buy sth for sb结构。

exercises.question:
请判断以下是否为句子：
birds can fly
exercises.explanation: birds can fly有完整的主谓结构，是句子。

exercises.question:
请判断以下是否为句子：
the birds in the cage which I bought yesterday
exercises.explanation: 这是一个名词短语，没有谓语动词。

exercises.question:
请判断以下是否为句子：
wait for me at the station.
exercises.explanation: wait for me at the station有完整的主谓结构（省略了主语you），是句子。
